title: Research YNAB plan behaviour in the live app: hide, delete (move-money popup), Uncategorized Transactions row, Ready to Assign identity

acceptance_criteria: Doc answers, with screenshots: what hiding a category does to its Available/Assigned/Activity and to Ready to Assign, where hidden categories are listed and how they are shown/unhidden; the delete flow (popup text, choices, what happens to transactions and assigned money); the automatic Uncategorized Transactions row (when it shows, what it counts, what clicking does); the exact identity between account balances, Ready to Assign and category Available incl. credit card payment categories and uncategorized card spending; a gap list versus our plan page.
